blocks.text: This module provides a modal settings dialog for visual theme customization. It allows players and creators to switch between built-in presets (Spacelab, Cyber, Apollo, Tactical, Aurora, Solar, Void), tune backdrop parameters (star density, nebula intensity, grid spacing, window opacity), toggle scanlines, and import or export custom theme configurations.

items: Provides ui.theme-customizer@1.0.0 through the THEME_CUSTOMIZERS key: a ThemeCustomizerFactory that creates ThemeCustomizer dialog instances.
The module requires no services at initialization. Each created dialog requires a ThemeController and a host DOM element.
Fills the ui.theme-customizer slot in platform profiles.
Initialization bundles the controls.css stylesheet asset, registers this guide, and provides THEME_CUSTOMIZERS.
create(options) mounts dialog controls into options.root and registers event listeners for presets, sliders and import/export buttons.
open(), close(), and toggle() control dialog visibility.
toggleGrid() toggles celestial grid visibility on the bound theme controller.
dispose removes dialog elements from the host DOM, unbinds event listeners and cancels active timers.

blocks.text: Theme controls are optional platform tools. Games that provide custom styling dialogs or lock visuals can replace or omit ui.theme-customizer without affecting physics, flight controls or world state.

Module version 0.1.0 uses API space-sim-game-api/2 and manifest format space-sim-module/2. Both are pre-freeze: dialog markup, events and options may evolve before API freeze with documented migration notes.

examples/modules/theme-customizer demonstrates creating a theme customizer dialog bound to a host DOM element and ThemeController, verifying open, toggle and close operations. Build and validate it from the repository root:

npm run module:build -- examples/modules/theme-customizer/module.json /tmp/example-theme-customizer.spacemod
npm run module:validate -- /tmp/example-theme-customizer.spacemod
